**Tests included** — Constitution v1.0.0 Principle III (NON-NEGOTIABLE) and SC-016 require one named `pytest` test per requirement, so test tasks are mandatory rather than optional here. Every FR-033…FR-060 is owned by a named task, following quickstart.md's traceability table.

### Independent test criteria

- **US1**: create with `burn_after_reading: true`, read once per route, confirm identical content/metadata to an ordinary paste, confirm every later read of either form is 404. Needs nothing from US2.
- **US2**: create with a password, confirm no-header / empty / wrong / duplicated / foreign password are all 403 while the correct password serves 200 on both routes, confirm deletion still works with the token alone. Needs nothing from US1.
- **US3**: run the pre-existing suite unmodified, then start against a directory of previous-version records and confirm unchanged content, id, timestamps, working delete tokens, and both flags `false`.

### Parallel opportunities

- Main axis: US1 (`tests/test_burn.py` + server read path) and US2 (`tests/test_password.py` + server validation/gate) after Phase 2 — single merge point on `src/pastebin/server.py`.
- Phase 2: T010 (`tests/conftest.py`) runs alongside T003–T009 (`src/pastebin/storage.py`).
- Phase 5: T034 and T036 need only Phase 2, so they can start before US1/US2 finish.
- Only one `[P]`-marked task in Polish (T040); the rest of each phase shares files, so marking them parallel would have been wrong.

### Suggested MVP scope

Phases 1–3 (T001–T021): one-time pastes, shippable alone. `protected` already appears in the read body and reads `false` until US2 lands.

### Format validation

Verified mechanically: 45 tasks, all matching `- [ ] T### [P?] [US#?] <description with file path>`; IDs sequential T001–T045 with no duplicates; story labels present on all 27 user-story tasks and absent from all 18 setup/foundational/polish tasks.

### Three sequencing traps called out explicitly in the file

New-field validation appends **after** the existing checks (else an existing 413 becomes a 400, breaking FR-039); the password gate runs **before** the one-time claim (else a wrong password destroys the paste, breaking FR-050); the claim runs after content is in memory and before the response is written (else concurrent reads both get 200, breaking FR-049).
